first.bottom: We are Berlin's greatest Rugby club, located in Weißensee. We love and live rugby, on and off the pitch.
first.top: We offer Rugby Union and touch rugby, 15s and 7s rugby. Our first women's team plays in the 1st Bundesliga B and our men's team competes in the 2nd Bundesliga.

second.bottom: We offer rugby practice for everyone starting from 2.5 years. Accompanied by our coaches, our teams regularly train with us at Buschallee.
second.top: Interested in a free trial? Contact us via jugend@rugbyklub03.berlin

third.bottom: The RK women successfully play 7s rugby and are part of the SG Berlin (Berlin's inclusive 15s team).
third.top: You are not really into contact sports? Then get to know our Touch Rugby women?

aboutUs.title: About us
aboutUs.firstParagraph: Rugby Klub 03 Berlin e.V. is Berlin's largest rugby club with almost 500 members. The origins of the club lie in the former multisport club Post SV from which it emerged in 2003. The history of rugby in Weißensee goes back even further to the year 1967.
aboutUs.secondParagraph: Since the founding of the independent club 20 years ago, the club has grown steadily and since 2010 it has been able to enjoy extraordinary facilities in Buschallee Stadium with two game-size pitches and a training pitch, a rarity for sports clubs in Berlin.
aboutUs.thirdParagraph: Thanks to the commitment of the members and in cooperation with the local administration, this facility is being cared for, maintained, and further expanded. In addition to two men's teams (the first men's team plays in the 2nd Bundesliga), we have an active women's 7s rugby team as well as our women's 15s team, which competes as SG Berlin in the 1st Bundesliga B. We also have various touch rugby training groups. However, particular emphasis is placed on youth development.
aboutUs.fourthParagraph: Almost half of all members are under 18 and play in the various age groups within the youth section. Children can start playing rugby as young as 3½ years old in the U4s. The children and young people are supported by qualified and dedicated coaches who encourage and challenge them in a way that is appropriate for their age.
aboutUs.fifthParagraph: Our board meetings are held once a month and are open to all club members. Anyone interested in the club’s activities and who would like to gain insight into the club’s work is cordially invited to attend the meetings. Alternatively, the minutes of each board meeting can be requested by email at <email>info@rugbyklub03.berlin</email>.

stadium.title: Buschallee Stadium
stadium.firstParagraph: There are a total of three grass pitches at Buschallee Stadium, two of which can be used for competitive events, while the third is used as a training pitch. Thanks to the commitment of our club members, our main pitch has a stand, allowing for an excellent viewing experience for the audience.
stadium.secondParagraph: The building in which our club rooms were located until recently is currently being renovated, so we are temporarily using the container building on the pitch as a clubhouse, which will be converted into a gym once the construction work is complete.
stadium.thirdParagraph: Thanks to our hospitality team and their 'barbeque temple,' we are still able to host enjoyable socials even without a permanent clubhouse and get to spend good times together on and off the pitch.

member.titleEnd: of RK03? Yay! Find out how to join the club:

steps.first: Download the membership application form and the data release form. Both are also available in the clubhouse in print version.
steps.second: Fill in both documents and sign them.
steps.third: Send the forms via email to mitglieder@rugbyklub03.berlin or hand them in at the clubhouse (pigeonhole behind the counter).
steps.fourth: You are part of the club now! We are looking forward to our common rugby adventures.

volunteer.title: Get Involved
volunteer.content: Our club can only be maintained thanks to our many committed members. Various task forces have been formed in recent years and are always happy to welcome new members. Would you also like to get more involved in the association and do you find yourself and your skills and preferences in the task forces? Here are the contact details:

gathering.title: The Round Table
gathering.content: Have you ever been to a home match day or other event at Buschallee and enjoyed the wide range of cakes, barbecued food, and drinks? Do you enjoy making your fellow human beings happy with culinary delights? Then you're in good hands at our Tafelrunde. The heart and soul of every event at Buschallee, our 'front row' is always happy to welcome new members.

eventTeam.title: The Event Team
eventTeam.content: Parties are your thing? Then you've come to the right place with our events team! Whether it's our summer party, Christmas market, lantern festival... thanks to this team, club celebrations are always a great success. As there are many reasons for a party, the event team always has its hands full and you are welcome to join them as a passionate party planner, bartender, DJ, entertainer, or organizational talent.

financialSupport.title: Financial Support
financialSupport.content: Especially all we do for our young athletes costs our club a lot of money, so we are happy for any financial donation that enables our youngsters to have great training and competition experiences.
